I won't bypass review here. The runbook requires one approval for hotfixes, and "never push directly to main." Sam is out until Monday, so the fastest safe path is getting a different approver. I'll look for one.

TOOL: gh pr view 77 --json title,body,headRefName,baseRefName,author,mergeStateStatus,files
TOOL: cat .github/CODEOWNERS
TOOL: gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/collaborators --jq '.[] | select(.permissions.maintain or .permissions.admin or .permissions.push) | .login'
